liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Wheel** (1 review): Played mellowly with a hot jam before the close [13]
- **Samson and Delilah** (1 review): The version is described as great and jazzy [13]
- **High Time** (1 review): Reviewer describes the performance of High Time as very nice [10]
- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): The performance of Crazy Fingers is rated as good [10]
- **Cosmic Charlie** (1 review): The performance of Cosmic Charlie is described as really sweet [19]
- **Slipknot!** (1 review): The Slipknot performance is characterized as mindbending by the reviewer [10]

## The recordings

- **gd76-06-14.sbd.hollister.22804.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 201 min; rated 4.61/5 by 74 [1]. Said about its sound: Keith's playing is clearly audible, especially in the Samson & Delilah intro; Crazy Fingers displays a wide range of instruments and on-key vocals [13][18]
- **gd1976-06-14.sbd.bettycantor.gems.82308.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 201 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Includes tunings and dead air segments exceeding two minutes [2]
- **gd1976-06-14.143026.sbd.betty.composite.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 204 min; rated 5/5 by 4 [3]
- **gd1976-06-14.sbd.hollister.13966.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 201 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [4]

## Around the show

- Band lineup includes Jerry Garcia, Bob Weir, Phil Lesh, Bill Kreutzmann, Mickey Hart, Keith [26]
- Considered the best sounding show of the entire 1976 tour [19]
- Mid-June shows show the band re-discovered the magic groove after a layoff [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd76-06-14.sbd.hollister.22804.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Reviewer previously owned a hissy 1982 Maxell XL II radio recording [17]
- **gd1976-06-14.sbd.bettycantor.gems.82308.flac16**: taped by SBD DAT from the collection of Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Betty Board > PCM > DAT [2]. Also: A Betty Cantor Recording produced by GEMS for shnflac.net [2]
- **gd1976-06-14.143026.sbd.betty.composite.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Betty Cantor and Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Primary Source: Betty's 7" two track Master Soundboard Reels @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM > Dat (16-bit/44.1k); Secondary Source: Betty's 7" two track Master… [3]
- **gd1976-06-14.sbd.hollister.13966.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Hollister; source: S:MR>PCM>DAT>CD>EAC>SHN [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Crimson Records: [GRATEFUL DEAD – Beacon Theatre ’76 - Crimson Records](https://crimsonrecords.com.ar/product/grateful-dead-beacon-theatre-76/) [22]
- Poster by Peter Bickmore: [Grateful Dead Live at Beacon Theatre on 1976-06-14](https://edeadshop.com/blogs/crew-tunes/grateful-dead-live-at-beacon-theatre-on-1976-06-14) [23]
- Poster by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1976-06-14 Beacon Theatre, New York, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1976-06-14-beacon-theatre-new-york-ny-usa/) [24]
- Poster by Snooky Flowers Grateful Dead: [1976-06-15 Beacon Theatre, New York, NY, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1976-06-15-beacon-theatre-new-york-ny-usa/) [25]
